# Morningside Center for Teaching Social Responsibility

> > An educational organization providing social-emotional learning (SEL) curricula, restorative practices, and teaching resources focused on racial equity, civic education, and community building in K-12 schools.

Morningside Center develops evidence-based programs like The 4Rs Program and provides teachable moment resources for educators in New York City and beyond. The organization integrates SEL with social justice education, offering classroom activities, restorative circles, and professional development centered on racial equity and democratic participation.

## Key Topics

- Social-Emotional Learning (SEL)
- The 4Rs Program
- Restorative Practices
- Racial Equity
- Teachable Moments
- Classroom Community Building
- Civic Education
- Active Listening
- Restorative Circles
- Social Responsibility
- Teaching Resources
- Courageous Conversation
- Literature-Based Learning
- Voting and Democracy
- Conflict Resolution

## Core Programs & Research

- [4Rs Research Study](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/4rs-research-study): Research study on 4Rs Program by U.S. Dept of Education & CDC
- [Centering Racial Equity](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/centering-racial-equity): Racial equity framework using Courageous Conversation & restorative practices

## SEL & Classroom Practices

- [Circles](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/circles-0): Restorative circles guide for classroom community and SEL
- [Active Listening](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/active-listening): Active listening activities for SEL and community building
- [Community](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/community): SEL classroom activities for relationship building and community care
- [Appreciations](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/appreciations): Gratitude and appreciation circle activities for SEL classrooms

## Civic Education & Current Events

- [2020 Election](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/2020-election-0): Teachable moments on 2020 election, primaries, and campaign finance
- [Biden Administration](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/biden-administration): Teachable moments on Biden admin, impeachment, and democracy topics
- [Climate Change](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/climate-change): Climate education resources including climate fiction materials

## Social Justice & History

- [Civil War](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/civil-war): Teaching resources on Civil War, Confederate monuments, and slavery
- [Colonialism](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/colonialism): Teaching resources on colonialism, indigenous peoples, and Columbus
- [China](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/china): Teachable moments on Hong Kong protests and Umbrella Revolution
- [Animal Rights](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/animal-rights): Teaching resources on animal rights, zoo ethics, and wildlife captivity

## Curriculum Resources

- [Books](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/books): Book reviews and literature resources on social responsibility themes
- [Common Core](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/common-core): Common Core ELA curriculum integrating literature and empathy

## Optional

- [Annual Reports](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/annual-reports): Archive of organizational annual reports
- [Annual Reports (Archive)](https://www.morningsidecenter.org/annual-reports-0): Annual reports on 4Rs, racial equity, and school change initiatives
